interaction: A loupe follows the pointer over a 24-frame film contact sheet and magnifies it 2× (a cloned, scaled copy of the sheet inside a round lens); clicking a frame circles it with an animated red grease-pencil stroke and adds it to 'Your picks', which can be attached to the enquiry form. On touch, the first tap slides the loupe onto a frame and a second tap circles it; with a keyboard, Tab into the sheet, arrow keys move the loupe frame by frame, Enter circles and Escape leaves.
notes: Frames are drawn SVG illustrations, not photographs. Picks are remembered in this browser only (localStorage, optional) and the enquiry ends in a demo message — nothing is sent.
